ICS 27.120.10; 71.060.01                         CHD 30Revised Standard from Last Update.1 SCOPEThis Indian Standard (Part 4) prescribes method of estimation of radium in environmental samples such as biological, mineralogical and water samples.2 REFERENCESThe following standards contain provisions which, through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision, and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of the standards indicated below:14194 (Part 2) : 2013 Radionuclides in environmental samples - Methods of estimation: Part 2 Gross alpha activity
